name: What are the energy efficiency benefits of new casement windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the energy efficiency benefits of new casement windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: New casement windows offer significant energy efficiency benefits due to advanced glazing technologies and superior sealing. Their crank-out design creates a tight seal against the frame when closed, minimizing air leaks. Features like low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, argon gas fills between panes, and multiple glass layers reduce heat transfer, keeping your home warmer in winter and cooler in summer, ultimately lowering energy consumption.
acceptedAnswer.description: New casement windows provide energy efficiency through tight seals, Low-E coatings, and gas fills, reducing heat transfer and energy bills.
